models.geometryBudget: Additional offline admission guard, not a change to the F3 loader or a measured phone budget

tools.legacyNormalizer: glTF Transform 4.3.0 / draco3dgltf 1.5.7 / sharp 0.34.4 (unchanged; not invoked by this profile)

blenderPbr.input: Core GLB 2.0, embedded JPEG or lossless PNG, triangle meshes
blenderPbr.output: Core GLB 2.0, same channels and pixel bytes; no universal decoding

channels.normal: linear tangent space +Y; no DirectX Y conversion
channels.occlusion: linear R; may share ORM image

blenderPbr.runtime: Offline Blender package ONLY; browser F3 JPEG policy unchanged

tools.decoder: Blender 5.2.1 glTF importer; PNG signature verified before import

surface.input: hash-verified existing CC0 WebP baseColor, <=256 px
surface.output: lossless RGB PNG, embedded in scene.glb
surface.limitation: Re-encoding a reduced albedo does not create PBR detail or source masters

surfaceCandidate.input: Pinned Poly Haven / Modelibr flat PNG albedo <=256 px, <=1 MiB
surfaceCandidate.channels: baseColor sRGB only; no fabricated normal/roughness/AO/height
surfaceCandidate.runtime: Offline Blender candidate catalog, NOT additions to the fifty approved browser surfaces
